description: This PHP class 'TimesheetRow' models a row in a timesheet, associating a project and activity with a set of dates and timesheet items. It includes methods for managing these associations, such as assigning timesheet items and retrieving totals.

classes.name: TimesheetRow
classes.description: Represents a row in a timesheet linked to a project, activity, and associated dates and timesheet items. Handles assignment of items and maintains total hours.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes TimesheetRow with project, activity, and dates, formatting dates to 'Ymd' and setting internal state.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Returns the project associated with this timesheet row.

methods.name: getProjectActivity
methods.description: Returns the project activity associated with this timesheet row.

methods.name: setDates
methods.description: Private method to format and set the dates for this row, stored as a key-value pair with date as key.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Retrieves the total of hours or units accumulated for this timesheet row.

methods.name: incrementTotal
methods.description: Increments the total by a given amount and returns the updated total.

methods.name: assignTimesheetItem
methods.description: Associates a TimesheetItem with the corresponding date in this row, throwing an exception if already assigned.

methods.name: getTimesheetItems
methods.description: Returns all assigned timesheet items for this row as an array.
